acceptanceJudgements.criterion: Malformed/timeout/tool-call responses never create an approved/publishable intent
acceptanceJudgements.basis: Read ollama.ts in full: tool_calls present or model mismatch rejects the envelope; strict schema reparse plus context revalidation (validateIntentProposal/validatePartitionProposal against exact goal/evidence); exactly one bounded repair then typed failure; shared monotonic deadline covers request/response/repair with AbortController cancellation; loopback transport rejects 3xx redirects, non-identity content-encoding and over-bound bodies. The orchestrator (M2.3 wiring) re-validates provider output and throws ProviderUnavailable before any persistence, so a failed/malformed/timeout response cannot produce an intent row. Injection tests assert failed status for forged authority. Rerun green.

acceptanceJudgements.criterion: Demo/mock/live modes remain distinguishable; endpoint is operator-controlled; no private egress to an unapproved provider
acceptanceJudgements.basis: ProviderResult records mode ('demo', 'ollama_protocol_mock' for injected transports, 'ollama_live'); missing config yields needs_configuration with no implicit demo fallback (constructor nulls invalid config); the endpoint regex accepts only numeric 127.0.0.1/[::1] /api/chat and comes exclusively from operator configuration (OllamaConfigSchema), never from request bodies (M2.3's IntentCreationInputSchema is strict {mode}); no DNS resolution, proxy, redirect or arbitrary route selection in the native transport. docs/model-configuration.md present in the manifest. Rerun green.

No paid endpoint, weight download or egress beyond loopback occurred; this review does not close live-model, real-runner or delivery gates.
